settings.label: Care & FAQ
settings.description: Practical answers in one place: care, delivery, returns and the questions clients ask most.

settings.label: Care guide
settings.description: Vacuuming, spills, rotation, sunlight and professional cleaning. The text exists today in the Journal and on the rug page.

settings.question: Are Corvo rugs made to order?
settings.answer: Yes. Every Corvo rug is made to order in our Portuguese atelier, hand-tufted for the room it will live in.

settings.question: Can I customize the size, shape and colours?
settings.answer: Yes. Dimensions, shape, materials and an infinite range of colours can all be tailored to your project. We prepare samples for your approval before production begins.

settings.question: How do I start a bespoke project?
settings.answer: On the Tailor your rug page: see a price guide for your idea and ask for a proposal. You can also write to us through the contact page. From there, the path is simple: consultation, design, sampling, production.

settings.question: What materials do you use?
settings.answer: [materials_count] materials. [materials_standard] are included in the price of every rug. [materials_plus] add a supplement. [materials_premium] are rare fibres with a price of their own. The Raw materials page describes each one and what it adds to the price.

settings.question: What does delivery cost, and do you deliver abroad?
settings.answer: We deliver worldwide. Delivery is not included in the price of a rug: it is quoted for each order, by destination and size, and confirmed with you after you order.

settings.question: How long does a rug take?
settings.answer: A rug is made to order and ships in [lead_weeks] weeks. With priority production it ships in [priority_weeks] weeks, for [priority_percent]% more. A custom colour, design or shape can take longer, and we confirm the date with your order.

settings.question: Do you work with interior designers and architects?
settings.answer: Yes. We offer dedicated trade support and sampling. Write to us to join the programme.

settings.question: How is the price of a rug worked out?
settings.answer: By area. Each design has a craft level, which sets its price per m², from [from_price] per m². Every rug page shows the price of its five standard sizes and works out the price of any other size, up to [max_size], as you type it. Prices include VAT.

settings.question: Can I see a sample first?
settings.answer: Yes. A [sample_size] sample of any rug costs [sample_price]. Order it from the page of the rug or from the Samples page.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel an order?
settings.answer: Yes, up to [change_hours] business hours after we confirm your order.

settings.question: What if something is wrong with my rug?
settings.answer: Every rug passes a quality control and is photographed before it leaves us. If you find a defect, tell us in writing within [claim_days] business days of receiving the rug, with photographs.

settings.question: Will the colours match exactly?
settings.answer: Colour can vary slightly between dye batches. This is normal in any textile and is not a defect.

settings.question: Can I return a rug?
settings.answer: No. Every rug is made to order for its buyer, so it cannot be returned or exchanged. An order can still be changed or cancelled up to [change_hours] business hours after we confirm it.

settings.question: Which colours can I choose?
settings.answer: Any colour. Every colour of a design can be changed: to one of the [palette_count] colours of the Open Palette at no extra cost, or to any other colour, matched to your reference, for [colour_price] per colour. The Colours page shows how.

settings.question: What is the largest rug you can make?
settings.answer: [max_size]. Every design can be made to measure in any size up to that, and its rug page works out the price as you type the size.

settings.question: How much does a bespoke rug cost?
settings.answer: From [from_price] per m², VAT included. The price per m² follows the craft level of the design, on a scale of 1 to [level_count]. The material, the pile, the size and custom colours can add to it. The Tailor your rug page works out a price guide for your idea.
